$comment: VALE modes (CONTRACT §4, §5.5, §9.6). Each mode = map + pick format + a complete RulesParams; queues layer overrides on top (queues.json). Rationale and every number's calibration: _design/sections/modes_economy.md.

modes.name: RIFT
modes.desc: Five against five on three roads. Draft your team, hold the Dialwood and its prizes, and silence the enemy Hourbell.

rules.$comment: Target 22-28 min. First wave 0:30, a wave every 30 s (3 Shieldwicks + 3 Glimwicks), a Greatwick every 3rd wave, a Brightwick every 2nd wave from 15:00, Wicks level up every 90 s. A fallen Lantern gives the breaking team Lanternwake (team_buffs.json) until it relights 4:00 later. Sudden death 40:00 is a backstop, not a pace setter: structures keep their protection and the Gorge Wind rises every 60 s (Wicks +20 % damage and structures +15 % damage taken per step, up to 8), respawns ×2 (W4 G5).

modes.name: BRIDGE
modes.desc: Five against five on one long road. Fighters come by lot, nobody can recall, and you shop at home, beside your standing Needles or while you wait to return.

rules.$comment: Target 14-20 min. Level 2 and 1,050 Gleam at the start (W4 re-key 2026-10-28, was level 3 and 1,300); shop at home, while dead, or within 6 m of your own standing Needles (shopAccess needles: the shop retreats as they fall); waves every 25 s from 0:20; XP ×2.4 on a cheaper table because five share one road; passive Gleam 4.0/s; no recall, the base fountain heals slowly and only inside the base circle, Mending Sunmotes on the span are the real sustain. The span's Needles, Lanterns and Hourbells stand at 0.7 of their RIFT health (tuning.structureHpMult). Respawns run long (8 s + 2 s a level, ×1.45 from 9:00) so a won fight turns into a push. Sudden death at 21:00 keeps every structure's protection: the Gorge Wind rises every 45 s (Wicks +25 % damage and structures +20 % damage taken per step, up to 8), respawns ×2 (W4 G5). Pacing (all-bot soak, role lineups, 20 seeds × adept + veteran): median 16.4 min, 8/40 reach sudden death, 0 cores fall with their chain standing.

modes.name: FRAY
modes.desc: Ten fighters, no teams, four lives each. Be the first to 12 kills or the last one standing, and finish high on the Hour Board.

rules.$comment: Target 8-11 min. teams 10 x perTeam 1: session gives every seat its own team and colorIndex = seat. Start at level 6 (ultimate ready) with 1,400 Gleam; income is passive Gleam, kills and Gleam Sunmotes; one shared Lampwright cart. 4 lives, first to 12 kills (the dial's twelve hours), else 11:00. From 8:00 the Noon Toll rings every 20 s and shows every living fighter to everyone for 5 s (W4 G6: nobody waits out the clock). Respawn 6-9 s at the hour-mark farthest from living enemies. placementPoints feed the Hour Board season tally (the sim does not read them).

fighterWeights.$comment: W4 G9: FRAY-only fighter weights (fighter-on-fighter damage dealt / taken), tuned on the soak's FRAY placement band 3.5-7.5 (50 seeds x adept + veteran, _harness/_reports/fw_W4_soak_polish_*). Lone divers and wardens over-play a free-for-all; setup kits (Nurrow's sleep, Vashil's chord) under-play it.
